why: NOT company-sourced. BrasilAgro is a foreign private issuer (CIK 0001499849, files 20-F and 6-Ks, June 30 fiscal year end); its Q3 FY26 results came via 6-K on 2026-05-08, so a 4T26/FY26 print in early September fits the regime. Multiple Brazilian financial-press reports state the company discloses 4T26 on 2026-09-03 and that it is in a quiet period until then, but I could not reach the company's own Calendario de Eventos (ri.brasil-agro.com returned an unpopulated template) or find a pre-announcing 6-K. Treat the date as press-corroborated, not company-confirmed.
session_evidence: UNSETTLED. No company statement of the release hour was recoverable. Brazilian issuers typically release after the B3 close (18:00 BRT), which is after the NYSE close, and hold the call the following morning - consistent with amc, but the baseline's own matched 6-K reactions include bmo, amc and intraday timestamps, so the calendar's amc label is not established. The last results 6-K was 2026-05-08.
where_to_look: The baseline's 8 'prints' have a 15-day inferred cadence and its own event_plausibility block says cadence_implausible - these are BrasilAgro's monthly/ad-hoc operational 6-Ks (harvest monitoring, planted-area and production-estimate updates) caught by the 6-K results-language matcher, not earnings. One such filing is on EDGAR from September 2026 already. Do not inherit the 1.35% median as an earnings base rate

The already-filed harvest-monitoring 6-Ks are the door: BrasilAgro pre-discloses planted area and production estimates for the 2025/26 crop through the year, which means most of the revenue is knowable before the print. Diff the latest estimate 6-K against the one before it

This is the fiscal-year-end print and the Brazilian sell-side says the 4T26 quarter itself is expected weak (Itau BBA models roughly R$56m adjusted EBITDA and a loss); the market's attention is on the FIRST 2026/27 crop guidance, not the quarter. That is the line to find
Farm sales: BrasilAgro's earnings are lumpy because they include gains on farmland disposals. Any farm-sale 6-K or CVM Fato Relevante filed since May is a larger swing factor than the crop

Portuguese-language CVM/B3 filings and the AGRO3 (B3) tape rather than the LND ADR - the ADR trades ~56k shares a day and the price discovery happens in Sao Paulo. Also check the BRL/USD move over the quarter, which sits between the two listings
Soybean, corn and sugar price curves for the April-June 2026 quarter and the hedge/forward-sale position disclosed in prior 6-Ks
already_in_the_wire: That 4T26 is expected to be weak on sugarcane and the absence of farm sales - published by Itau BBA and widely covered in Brazilian press in late August 2026
The 2025/26 harvest planted-area and production estimates, already disclosed by 6-K
